#### 启动与依赖

| 条件 | 用途 | 缺失或边界 |
|---|---|---|
| target DSH0.2.1-rc.2接口与pnpm | 安装/preset/hostImport | README≥0.2.1非跨新版验收 |
| 模型route/凭据与网络 | 分析/selector/coverage/child | 错误不总静默，资源额外 |
| official/library打包目录 | Skill实际可用 | build缺源warn跳过，checkout不含skills |
| Python3.11+与numpy/scipy/pandas | semantic/file_digest及replay | 不支持的生信依赖重放失败 |
| 新鲜公共任务目录与合同/inputs | delivery验收 | 完整性非OS隔离，敏感数据须另管 |

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源 | 人工时间/未知 |
|---|---|---|
| 首次 | 模型/DSH/Python与技能资源 | 环境安装、合同与方法审阅，工时费用未知 |
| 持续 | selector额外调用、分析计算、replay临时副本 | 解释规则、未核列与统计诊断 |
| 失败恢复 | 最多多轮修复、子分析/重跑、保留目录 | 对账原结果/新结果与进程，成本未知 |
| MAGI可选 | 作者称约倍增时间/费用，非本次实测 | 同账号盲法与arbiter额外审阅 |
| 退出 | 留存数据/日志/备份 | 停用不撤外发/脚本副作用 |

[Q01](#research-q01) 和 [Q04](#research-q04) 把生信方法组织与公共合同、固定原始输入规则和干净重放连成可追溯修复循环，超过只有persona的包装；引用/规则仍由模型解释，不等于完整科学验证。
[Q04](#research-q04) 默认coverage关闭且部分列检查可accepted，重放一致不能排同算法错误；[Q03](#research-q03) 时间提示非总预算，[Q05](#research-q05) MAGI非隔离盲法且发布有非原子恢复窗口。应明确每次究竟核过哪些科学主张。

technical.rationale: [Q01/Q04]相对persona+通用agent，合同/原源规则/replay修复系统集成novelty50%（18），超过局部25%；既有模型/统计/DSH/PTC不足75%新算法。mechanism50%（15）：lib/delivery:42-117将停止条件改为有receipt的校验修复，超过提示串接25%；semantic_check:155-158未核列可过与模型解释不足75%。transferability50%（10）：公开合同/源规则可跨表格分析复用，超过单生信入口25%；Python/任务合同依赖和未知跨域不足75%。simplification50%（8）：自动选择和一次性检查减少分散操作，超过快捷入口25%；合同编写、依赖与专家审阅仍重不足75%。

business.rationale: [Q01/Q04]把分析后检查放入交付修复循环，workflow50%（18）超过局部提醒25%；未覆盖全部科学字段/开放任务不足75%。delivery50%（15）：submission+合同/replay receipt相对单结果是新组织，超过文件换格式25%；accepted不证明科学正确，未达75%可靠新验收。reach50%（10）：生信persona与技能面向湿实验用户、减少方法查找，超过单UI25%；仍需合同/统计专家且资源未确认，不足75%。economics0%：[Q05]用户仍承担模型/本地计算与审阅，MAGI增加同模式调用，不改变25%的计费/资源归属/服务结构；作者未复现节时不能充作经济创新。

recommendation.reason: 需要规范化分析交付的生信研究者可以观察BioDSH的技能与合同检查流程。相较通用编码agent，它增加原始数据规则、重放和失败修复记录，但accepted仍可能含未核科学字段。若关键列未覆盖、解释与规范矛盾或复核发布中断，应停止扩大并回专家脚本和独立统计审阅。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)README:11-17与delivery实际流程明确生信规范/复核摩擦，75%超过仅用途50%；无独立持续需求和非专家成功数据不足100%。

advantage.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04)delivery/semantic/replay提供50%可解释增量，超过persona25%；未核列accepted、方法解释和当前资源不明，不足75%可靠科学改善。

evidence.rationale: [Q02-Q05]源规则、终态/receipt/修复与MAGI默认可查，50%足以专家去敏金标机制研究，高于只有声明25%；本次未运行、技能资源未确认与作者基准未复现，不达75%。

cost.rationale: [Q05](#research-q05)多模型/replay、依赖与合同编写、非原子MAGI恢复使成本25%（5）；可保存原始数据退回专家脚本超过0，但全周期费用/时间未知且发布失败需人工恢复不足50%。

      "content": "# dsh-biodsh\n\n[中文](#中文说明) | English\n\nBioDSH for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): a bundle that adds a **BioDSH agent preset** for bioinformatics work. Your other presets are not changed.\n\nThe BioDSH preset is the standard preset of your dsh release plus:\n\n| Part | What it does |\n|---|---|\n| BioDSH persona | Answers for doctors and wet-lab scientists, in the user's language; keeps raw data untouched; reports what was actually computed. When the working folder contains a machine-readable output specification (`TABLE_CONTRACT.json`, `CLAIMS.json`, …), a one-line persona and a specification-first instruction replace it. |\n| BioDSH skills | 17 validated BioDSH workflows in the session skill catalog: single-cell QC, clustering, annotation and treatment response; bulk RNA-seq limma-voom; survival (KM, Cox), regression with robust SEs and ANOVA designs, each checked against R; workflow building, and more. |\n| Skill library | 2000+ community bioinformatics, clinical and data skills. Kept out of the catalog so it stays small and cacheable; the model searches it with the `skill_library` tool, and you can still run any of them with `/name`. |\n| Skill selection | On each new message, a model reads the whole catalog (BioDSH skills and library) and injects the one or two skills that fit the request, in the same form as `/name`. |\n| Convergence guard | In a long turn, asks the agent to save its code and finish the needed checks (900 s, or 60 steps), then to report honestly what is unfinished (1100 s, or 80 steps); ends a turn past 90 steps. It never asks the agent to guess. |\n| Delivery gate | For tasks that come with a public output specification (table contract, claims), checks the saved outputs against it, checks declared columns against the original inputs, and replays the analysis script in a clean folder before the turn may end; on failure it returns the concrete errors for repair. |\n| BioDSH-MAGI | **Experimental, off by default.** **Multi-Analyst Gated Inspection.** When an analysis with an output specification shows a risk signal (the delivery gate needed repairs, a source check failed, or the run was long), a second analyst redoes it from the original inputs in a separate folder without seeing the first result, and an arbiter compares both and delivers only after its own executable, cell-by-cell checks pass the delivery gate. Modes: `off` (default), `adaptive`, `always`. In our evaluation it rescued only a few tasks while roughly doubling time and cost. The first analyst's result is kept under `.biodsh-magi/`. |\n\n## Install\n\nRequires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1 or later and [pnpm](https://pnpm.io/installation) on `PATH` (dsh's plugin manager runs pnpm).\n\n- **Command line**\n\n  ```bash\n  dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-biodsh\n  ```\n\n- **Web UI**: open **Plugins**, choose **Install**, enter `dsh-biodsh`.\n- **Ask the agent** (Creator mode): \"install the dsh-biodsh bundle\".\n\nRestart dsh after installing, then pick **BioDSH** in the agent preset menu, or make it the default:\n\n```yaml\n# ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml\n- id: agent-preset-registry\n  config:\n    default: biodsh\n```\n\n**BioDSH (PTC)** (`biodsh-ptc`) is the same preset with programmatic tool calling, like dsh's own `ptc` preset: the model calls tools from one program per step, so writing a script, running it and checking its output take one step instead of three. On 15 development tasks it cut the median from 23 to 16 steps and from 129 s to 97 s at the same accuracy.\n\n## Configure\n\nThe bundle adds a settings namespace `biodsh` (a Host row, so you never edit the preset itself). Change it in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`, on the Settings page, or with `settings.mutate`; most fields apply to the next step without a restart.\n\n```yaml\n# ~/.dsh/settings.yaml\nbiodsh:\n  selectProvider: deepseek-official   # skill selection model; empty = same route as the agent\n  selectModel: deepseek-flash\n  selectMaxInject: 2\n  guardSoftSeconds: 900               # save code, finish needed checks (time is the main signal; steps are a backstop)\n  guardSoftSteps: 60\n  guardHardSeconds: 1100              # report what is unfinished; no guessing\n  guardHardSteps: 80\n  guardMaxSteps: 90                   # end the turn (0 = no cap)\n  magiMode: off                       # BioDSH-MAGI (experimental): off | adaptive | always\n  magiSteps: 60                       # adaptive: review runs with at least this many steps\n  magiSeconds: 900                    # ...or this many seconds\n  library: true                       # 2000+ skill library and the skill_library tool (restart to apply)\n```\n\n## Versions\n\nA dsh agent preset restates its full plugin list, so each `dsh-biodsh` release is built against one dsh release (`dshTarget` in `package.json`) by `scripts/build.mjs`, which copies the standard preset of that release and changes only the persona and the three BioDSH rows. `scripts/install-test.mjs` installs a build through dsh's own plugin manager in a fresh home and runs a real turn on the preset.\n\n## Licenses\n\nBioDSH code and skills: MIT. Skills under `skills/library` come from community repositories and keep their own licenses; see each skill's folder.\n\n---\n\n## 中文说明\n\n为 DeepSeek Harness 增加一个 **BioDSH 智能体预设**，用于生信分析。你原有的预设不受影响。\n\nBioDSH 预设 = 你当前 dsh 版本的标准预设，再加上：\n\n- **BioDSH 人设**：面向医生和湿实验科学家，跟随用户语言作答，不改原始数据，如实报告实际算了什么。工作目录里有机器可读的输出规范（`TABLE_CONTRACT.json`、`CLAIMS.json` 等）时，换成一句话人设和“按规范工作”的说明。\n- **BioDSH 官方技能**：17 个经过验证的流程（单细胞质控/聚类/注释/治疗响应、bulk RNA-seq limma-voom、生存分析 KM/Cox、稳健标准误回归、方差分析设计等，统计类均与 R 逐项对照），出现在会话技能目录里。\n- **技能库**：2000+ 社区技能，不放进目录（目录保持小而稳定，利于缓存）。模型用 `skill_library` 工具检索，你也可以用 `/技能名` 直接调用。\n- **技能精选**：每条新消息，用模型对照全部技能选出最合适的一两个，以 `/name` 同样的形式注入。\n- **收敛护栏**：长任务到 900 秒（或 60 步）提醒先保存代码、做完必要核验；1100 秒（或 80 步）要求如实报告未完成的部分；超过 90 步停止本轮。不会要求它猜答案。\n- **交付检查**：带输出规范（表格合同、结论声明）的任务，在结束前核对输出结构、把声明的列对照原始数据，并在干净目录重放分析脚本；不通过就把具体错误交回去修。\n- **BioDSH-MAGI 复核**（实验性功能，默认关闭；Multi-Analyst Gated Inspection，多分析员门控核查）：带输出规范的分析如果出现风险信号（交付检查要返修、与原始数据核对失败、运行过长），会另开一位分析员在独立目录里从原始数据重做一遍，看不到第一份结果；再由裁决员对照两份结果，写出可执行的逐格核查并通过交付检查后才交付。三档：`off` 关闭（默认）、`adaptive` 自适应、`always` 每次都复核。评测中它只救回少数题，时间和费用约翻倍。第一份结果保存在 `.biodsh-magi/` 里。\n\n设置：在 `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` 写 `biodsh:` 一段（字段见上方英文说明），或在设置页修改，大多数改动下一步就生效。\n\n安装：需要 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1 及以上，并且 `PATH` 里有 pnpm。\n\n- 命令行：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-biodsh`\n- 网页：「插件」→「安装」，输入 `dsh-biodsh`\n\n装好后重启 dsh，在智能体预设菜单里选 **BioDSH**，或按上面的 YAML 设为默认。\n\n**BioDSH (PTC)**（`biodsh-ptc`）是同一预设加上程序化工具调用（同 dsh 自带的 `ptc` 预设）：模型每步写一段程序来调用工具，写脚本、运行、检查输出一步完成。在 15 道开发题上，步数中位数从 23 降到 16，耗时从 129 秒降到 97 秒，正确率不变。\n"

      "content": "<div align=\"center\">\n\n<a href=\"http://43.167.193.205/\"><picture><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"docs/brand/png/readme-banner-dark.png\"><img src=\"docs/brand/png/readme-banner-light.png\" alt=\"BioDSH\" width=\"100%\"></picture></a>\n\n**A bioinformatics agent for clinicians and wet-lab scientists. Describe the analysis in plain language and get the result, with no coding.**\n\n[中文](README.zh.md) · [Download](#download) · [dsh plugin](#use-it-inside-deepseek-harness) · [Results](#results)\n\n[![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/sagirimo/BioDSH?include_prereleases&label=release)](https://github.com/sagirimo/BioDSH/releases)\n[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-biodsh?label=dsh-biodsh)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-biodsh)\n[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)\n\n</div>\n\nYou add your data (single-cell `h5ad`, count matrices, clinical tables, gene lists…) and ask a question such as *\"Do responders and non-responders differ in CD8A expression?\"* The agent loads the data, picks the right method, writes and runs the code, and reports the conclusion along with the figures, the tables and every step it took.\n\nBioDSH runs on your own computer and is built on [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It comes in two forms: a one-click **desktop app** and a **dsh plugin** (`dsh-biodsh`).\n\n<picture>\n  <source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"docs/brand-showcase/skills-dark-en.png\">\n  <img src=\"docs/brand-showcase/skills-light-en.png\" width=\"100%\" alt=\"BioDSH 1.0 skill hub preview\">\n</picture>\n\n<sub>BioDSH 1.0 skill hub (preview; catalog entries and counts are illustrative). [Interactive preview](http://43.167.193.205/brand/?lang=en)</sub>\n\n## Why BioDSH\n\n- **Plain language in, conclusions out.** You don't need to write code or set up an environment. A Python analysis environment (scanpy, anndata, pandas, statsmodels, matplotlib…) installs itself on first launch.\n- **Validated methods instead of improvised code.** It ships 17 official analysis skills: single-cell QC, clustering, annotation and treatment response; bulk RNA-seq with limma-voom; Kaplan–Meier and Cox survival; regression with robust standard errors; ANOVA designs; and more. The statistics skills were checked against R on tens of thousands of cases (for example, 101,587 survival comparisons with zero mismatches).\n- **The right skill picked automatically.** For each request, a model selects the one or two relevant skills from the 17 official skills and a library of 2,000+ community skills, and loads only those, so the context stays small. Community skills are scanned, and those that ship benchmark answers are excluded.\n- **Frontier-level accuracy from an inexpensive model.** With DeepSeek V4 Flash, BioDSH matches Claude Code driven by Opus on our 120-task benchmark (102 vs 103) at about a third of the API-equivalent cost (see [Results](#results)).\n- **Long analyses always finish.** A convergence guard keeps the agent from running in circles. It first asks the agent to wrap up, then asks for a final answer, so you always get a result.\n- **Your data stays safe.** Original files are never modified, and every analysis writes into a new folder. In offline mode BioDSH talks only to a model on your own machine or intranet, which suits hospitals and labs.\n- **Every result can be traced.** Every step goes into an append-only session log that you can review, export or hand to a reviewer.\n- **Reusable workflows.** You can save a finished analysis as a workflow and rerun it on new data. BioDSH can also build a workflow from an existing script, notebook or methods paragraph.\n- **Your choice of model.** BioDSH works with DeepSeek's official API, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or a local or intranet model, and you can configure several of them side by side.\n\n## Download\n\n| Version | Platform | Get it |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| **1.0.0** (latest) | Windows 10/11 | [`BioDSH_1.0.0_x64-setup.exe`](https://github.com/sagirimo/BioDSH/releases/latest) |\n| **1.0.0** (latest) | macOS 12+ (Apple silicon) | [`BioDSH_1.0.0_aarch64.dmg`](https://github.com/sagirimo/BioDSH/releases/latest) |\n\n- **Upgrading from 0.3.0:** installed 0.3.0 apps are not auto-updated to 1.0; install 1.0.0 over it when you are ready. Your projects, files and conversations are never deleted, but conversations recorded with 0.3.0 may not open in 1.0.\n- **Windows:** on first run, click *More info → Run anyway*. The installer is not code-signed.\n- **macOS:** the app is not notarized, so macOS may report it as \"damaged\". Move it to Applications and run `sudo xattr -cr /Applications/BioDSH.app` once.\n\nThe stable app checks for updates in the background and installs them with one click. Updates are signature-verified, and the app sends no data when it checks.\n\n## Use it inside DeepSeek Harness\n\nIf you already use dsh, you can install the BioDSH agent as a plugin without the desktop app:\n\n```bash\ndsh plugin --profile web add dsh-biodsh\n```\n\nYou can also install it from the dsh web UI: **Plugins → Install → `dsh-biodsh`**. Restart dsh, then pick **BioDSH** in the agent preset menu. Your other presets are left unchanged. The plugin requires dsh 0.2.1+ and pnpm. For details, see [`packages/dsh-biodsh`](packages/dsh-biodsh).\n\nIf you only want the skills, the official skills are plain dsh `SKILL.md` folders. `./scripts/install-into-dsh.sh <your-project>/.agents/skills` copies them in (use `install-into-dsh.ps1` on Windows).\n\n## Results\n\nFrom our preprint (*arXiv link coming*). The benchmark is BioDSH-Bench-120: 120 analysis tasks in 10 subdomains, graded by replaying each submitted script against a public table contract, with no LLM judge. Every agent runs in the same read-isolated sandbox, one run per configuration.\n\n**Same model, different agent: a tie.** With every agent on DeepSeek V4 Flash:\n\n| Agent (DeepSeek V4 Flash) | Correct / 120 |\n| --- | --- |\n| BioDSH + blind second analysis | 102 |\n| DeepSeek Harness without BioDSH | 101 |\n| BioDSH | 98 |\n| Codex CLI | 98 |\n| Claude Code | 96 |\n\nNo pairwise difference is statistically significant.\n\n**The model matters more than the agent.** With their own models, Codex ranges from 76 to 116 and Claude Code from 95 to 103. On BixBench-Verified-50, run behind a network allow-list, all four agents score 33–34/50.\n\nWhat BioDSH adds is therefore not accuracy on the same model but the environment around it: a desktop app, vetted skills, isolated and auditable runs, and a choice of local or remote models.\n\n**A note on benchmark contamination.** Coding agents read whatever files they can reach and look answers up online, and several widely shared community skills ship benchmark answers. BioDSH's skill library is scanned for this, and the contaminated skills we found are excluded (`dsh-biodsh` 1.0.0-preview.2 and later).\n\n## Build from source\n\nYou need Node.js 22+, stable Rust and the [Tauri prerequisites](https://tauri.app/start/prerequisites/).\n\n```bash\ncd desktop\nnpm ci\nnode scripts/stage-dsh.mjs     # dsh runtime + the dsh-biodsh bundle\nnode scripts/sync-skills.mjs   # official skills → resources\nnpm run tauri dev              # or: npm run tauri build\n```\n\n| Path | Contents |\n| --- | --- |\n| `desktop/` | The desktop app: React UI (`src/`), Rust backend (`src-tauri/`) and build scripts. |\n| `packages/dsh-biodsh/` | The `dsh-biodsh` plugin: BioDSH presets, skill selection and the convergence guard. |\n| `biodsh-core/skills/` | Official skills. |\n\n## License\n\n[MIT](LICENSE) for BioDSH's own code. Bundled components (DeepSeek Harness, community skills, Python packages) keep their own licenses.\n\nBioDSH is an independent project built on [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It is not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.\n"

      "content": "// Build the dsh-biodsh bundle for one dsh release.\n//\n// An agent preset has no inheritance: a new preset restates its complete plugin list. So the BioDSH preset is generated\n// from the standard preset shipped in the target dsh (dsh-web-app/presets/standard.patch.yml) with three changes:\n// the persona prefix, the BioDSH plugins inserted after tool-skill, and id/name/description/order. `!!js` conditions are\n// carried over verbatim. Re-run for every dsh release the bundle targets and publish with the matching version.\n// Also copies the skills: skills/official (catalog) and skills/library (community library, hidden from the catalog).\n//\n// usage: node scripts/build.mjs --dsh <dsh runtime dir with node_modules> [--official <dir>] [--library <dir>] [--no-skills]\nimport { readFileSync, writeFileSync, existsSync, rmSync, cpSync, readdirSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';\nimport { createRequire } from 'node:module';\nimport path from 'node:path';\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';\n\nconst here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));\nconst pkgDir = path.join(here, '..');\nconst repo = path.join(pkgDir, '..', '..');\nconst arg = (k, d) => { const i = process.argv.indexOf(k); return i >= 0 ? process.argv[i + 1] : d; };\nconst runtime = path.resolve(arg('--dsh', path.join(repo, 'desktop', 'dsh-runtime')));\nconst official = path.resolve(arg('--official', path.join(repo, 'desktop', 'resources', 'skills')));\nconst library = path.resolve(arg('--library', path.join(repo, 'desktop', 'resources', 'community-skills')));\n\nconst PERSONA = [\n  'You are BioDSH (中文名同样叫 BioDSH), a bioinformatics assistant powered by the {{model}} model. Your users are doctors and',\n  'wet-lab scientists, often with no programming or bioinformatics background.',\n  '',\n  'When greeted or asked who you are, introduce yourself as BioDSH 生信助手 and give three concrete examples they could ask,',\n  'e.g. 「帮我看看这份单细胞数据的质量」「比较有效和无效病人的细胞组成差异」「解读这个结果文件夹」. Never call yourself a generic coding agent.',\n  '',\n  'How you work on analyses:',\n  '- Reply in the language the user writes in. Plain language first, technical detail second; briefly explain any format,',\n  '  tool or statistic you mention.',\n  '- Skills: BioDSH skills are listed in the session catalog; skills that clearly fit a request may already be injected as',\n  '  <skill_content>; follow them. For a specific method, tool or database no listed skill covers, search the 2000+ skill',\n  '  library with the skill_library tool before improvising.',\n  '- Keep original data untouched; write outputs to a new subfolder and tell the user its name.',\n  '- Stay within the working folder and the files the user gave you. Do not search parent or unrelated folders for',\n  '  examples, earlier results or reference answers; when a format is unclear, follow the files provided or ask.',\n  '- Check the units and the unit of inference (patients vs cells vs samples), state assumptions, and report what you',\n  '  actually computed, including failures. Do not present a finished run as a validated scientific result.',\n  '- When a decision is needed (thresholds, which group is the control), ask one clear question instead of guessing.',\n  '',\n  'When the request comes with a written specification (a task description, a protocol, output contracts):',\n  '- Read all of it, including every file it names, before writing code. Then map the ambiguous or transformed output',\n  '  fields to their source or formula, units, row scope and missing-value rules. Keep raw identifiers and values separate',\n  '  from derived representations; use named ID columns. Do not silently trim values, change units or infer an undefined',\n  '  field from its name: look again in the provided material, and say what stays unresolved.',\n  '- Join and group by the identifiers the specification names (sample labels, IDs), never by column or row order.',\n  '- An output column with the same name as an input column carries the input value unchanged, unless the specification',\n  '  explicitly defines a new value for that column (a derived quantity with a similar name is not that column).',\n  '- Batch related input inspection and verification; each step is a model call the user waits for. Write a complete first',\n  '  implementation after resolving the specification, then make targeted fixes to failed checks rather than rewrites.',\n  '  The script must run from any location under any file name: take paths from its arguments, refer to itself through',\n  '  __file__. If a time or CPU budget is stated, measure the script against it and vectorize loops over rows or genes.',\n  '- Check the saved outputs, re-read from disk, with rules taken from the specification and independently of the code',\n  '  that produced them: JSON containers, exact key sets, scalar types, allowed options and table bindings; then source',\n  '  values kept, units, row masks and group sizes, before repeating expensive fits. Do not add wrappers or fields the',\n  '  specification does not request. A successful run or reproducible numbers alone do not validate the output contract.',\n  '  Print every check in one run, fix what it reports in one edit, and rerun the same check.',\n].join('\\n');\n\n// ---- read the shipped standard preset (keep !!js values) ----\nconst YAML = createRequire(path.join(runtime, 'package.json'))('yaml');\nconst src = path.join(runtime, 'node_modules', '@deepseek-ai', 'dsh-web-app', 'presets', 'standard.patch.yml');\nconst dshVersion = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(runtime, 'node_modules', '@deepseek-ai', 'dsh', 'package.json'), 'utf8')).version;\nconst JS = Symbol('js');\nconst rows = YAML.parse(readFileSync(src, 'utf8'), { customTags: [{ tag: 'tag:yaml.org,2002:js', resolve: (s) => ({ [JS]: s }) }] });\nconst standard = rows[0].insert.find((r) => r.id === 'preset-standard');\nif (!standard) throw new Error(`no preset-standard in ${src}`);\n// shallow copies: structuredClone would drop the symbol that marks !!js values\nconst plugins = standard.config.plugins.map((p) => ({ ...p, ...(p.config && !Array.isArray(p.config) ? { config: { ...p.config } } : {}) }));\nconst at = (id) => { const i = plugins.findIndex((p) => p.id === id); if (i < 0) throw new Error(`standard preset has no ${id}`); return i; };\nplugins[at('persona')].config = { ...(plugins[at('persona')].config || {}), prefix: PERSONA };\n// The BioDSH persona row picks a one-line persona when the folder ships a written specification (lib/persona.js).\nplugins[at('persona')].name = 'dsh-biodsh/persona';\nplugins.splice(at('tool-skill') + 1, 0,\n  { id: 'biodsh-skills', name: 'dsh-biodsh/skills' },\n  { id: 'biodsh-skill-select', name: 'dsh-biodsh/select' },\n  // Delivery gate + BioDSH-MAGI (lib/delivery.js, lib/magi.js), before the guard as in the v18 evaluated configuration.\n  { id: 'biodsh-delivery', name: 'dsh-biodsh/delivery' },\n  { id: 'biodsh-step-guard', name: 'dsh-biodsh/guard' });\nplugins.splice(at('persona') + 1, 0, { id: 'biodsh-context', name: 'dsh-biodsh/context' });\nconst preset = { id: 'preset-biodsh', name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset', config: {\n  id: 'biodsh', name: 'BioDSH', order: 0.5,\n  description: 'Bioinformatics assistant: BioDSH skills in the catalog, a 2000+ skill library, automatic skill selection and a convergence guard.',\n  plugins } };\n// PTC variant, like the official `ptc` preset (standard + tool-presentation ptc): the model sees one run_code tool and\n// writes a program that calls the other tools, so writing a script, running it and printing checks take one step.\nconst ptcPlugins = [...plugins];\nptcPlugins.splice(at('tool-web') + 1, 0, { id: 'tool-presentation', name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-tool-presentation', config: { mode: 'ptc' } });\nconst ptcPreset = { id: 'preset-biodsh-ptc', name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset', config: {\n  id: 'biodsh-ptc', name: 'BioDSH (PTC)', order: 0.6,\n  description: 'BioDSH with programmatic tool calling: tools are called from one program per step (fewer model calls).',\n  plugins: ptcPlugins } };\n\n// ---- serialize with !!js preserved ----\n// Host row `biodsh` carries the user-facing settings (a settings namespace); the preset rows read it.\nconst settingsRow = { id: 'biodsh', name: 'dsh-biodsh/settings' };\nlet text = YAML.stringify([{ insert: [settingsRow, preset, ptcPreset] }], { lineWidth: 0, aliasDuplicateObjects: false, customTags: [{ tag: 'tag:yaml.org,2002:js', identify: (v) => v && typeof v === 'object' && JS in v,\n  stringify: (item) => JSON.stringify(item.value[JS]) }] });\ntext = `# dsh-biodsh bundle patch, generated by scripts/build.mjs from the standard preset of dsh ${dshVersion}.\\n`\n  + '# Adds the BioDSH agent presets (native and PTC) and their settings row `biodsh`; other presets are not changed.\\n'\n  + '# Do not edit by hand: rebuild for each dsh release. Change settings in settings.yaml (`biodsh:`) or the Settings page.\\n' + text;\nwriteFileSync(path.join(pkgDir, 'cordis.patch.yml'), text);\n\n// ---- version follows the dsh release it was built against ----\nconst pkgFile = path.join(pkgDir, 'package.json');\nconst pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync(pkgFile, 'utf8'));\npkg.version = `${pkg.version.split('+')[0].replace(/-dsh.*$/, '')}`;\npkg.dshTarget = dshVersion;\nwriteFileSync(pkgFile, JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + '\\n');\n\n// ---- skills ----\nif (!process.argv.includes('--no-skills')) {\n  const out = path.join(pkgDir, 'skills');\n  rmSync(out, { recursive: true, force: true });\n  for (const [from, to] of [[official, 'official'], [library, 'library']]) {\n    if (!existsSync(from)) { console.warn(`skip ${to}: ${from} missing`); continue; }\n    mkdirSync(path.join(out, to), { recursive: true });\n    for (const d of readdirSync(from)) if (existsSync(path.join(from, d, 'SKILL.md'))) cpSync(path.join(from, d), path.join(out, to, d), { recursive: true });\n    console.log(`skills/${to}: ${readdirSync(path.join(out, to)).length}`);\n  }\n}\nconsole.log(`cordis.patch.yml built from dsh ${dshVersion} standard preset (${plugins.length} plugins)`);\n"

      "content": "// BioDSH persona: the same prefix/suffix row as @deepseek-ai/dsh-persona, except that the prefix is chosen per agent.\n//\n// When the working folder ships a machine-readable output specification (CONTRACT_FILES), the agent gets a one-line\n// persona and works from the specification; otherwise it gets the full BioDSH persona from the preset. On the\n// 120-task benchmark the short persona was as accurate as the full one (all of those tasks ship a specification);\n// open questions and chat were not evaluated with it, so they keep the full persona.\nimport { existsSync } from 'node:fs';\nimport path from 'node:path';\nimport { hostImport } from './host.js';\nimport { CONTRACT_FILES, workspaceRoot } from './task_policy.js';\n\nconst { default: z } = await hostImport('@deepseek-ai/schemastery');\n\n// Section names owned by @deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt (PERSONA_PREFIX_SECTION / PERSONA_SUFFIX_SECTION).\nconst PREFIX_SECTION = 'deployment:persona-prefix';\nconst SUFFIX_SECTION = 'deployment:persona-suffix';\n\nexport const SPEC_PERSONA = 'You are BioDSH, a bioinformatics analysis assistant powered by the {{model}} model.';\n\nexport const name = 'biodsh-persona';\nexport const inject = ['systemPrompt'];\nexport const Config = z.object({\n  prefix: z.string().required(),\n  suffix: z.string().default(''),\n});\n\nexport function hasSpecification(root, hasFile = existsSync) {\n  return Boolean(root) && CONTRACT_FILES.some(n => hasFile(path.join(root, n)));\n}\n\nexport function apply(ctx, config) {\n  const prefix = (context) => (hasSpecification(workspaceRoot(ctx, context?.agent)) ? SPEC_PERSONA : config.prefix);\n  ctx.effect(() => ctx.systemPrompt.section({\n    name: PREFIX_SECTION,\n    order: ctx.systemPrompt.getSectionOrder('DEPLOYMENT_PERSONA_PREFIX'),\n    text: prefix,\n  }), 'biodsh-persona.section()');\n  ctx.effect(() => ctx.systemPrompt.section({\n    name: SUFFIX_SECTION,\n    order: ctx.systemPrompt.getSectionOrder('DEPLOYMENT_PERSONA_SUFFIX'),\n    text: config.suffix ?? '',\n  }), 'biodsh-persona.suffix()');\n}\n"

      "path": "packages/dsh-biodsh/lib/skills.js",
      "content": "// BioDSH skills: one skill provider for the bundled BioDSH skills plus the `skill_library` tool.\n//\n// Official BioDSH skills (skills/official) are model-invocable and appear in the session catalog. The community library\n// (skills/library, 2000+) is registered with modelInvocable:false: it stays out of the catalog, so the catalog is small\n// and stable (the official tool-skill re-publishes it only when its digest changes, which keeps the prompt cache), while\n// skills remain loadable through ctx.skills.get (biodsh-skill-select injects the ones that fit) and through\n// `skill_library`, which lets the model search the library mid-task. Users can still invoke any of them with /name.\nimport { readdirSync, readFileSync, existsSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';\nimport path from 'node:path';\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';\nimport { hostImport } from './host.js';\nimport { setting } from './settings.js';\n\nconst { defineTool } = await hostImport('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools');\n\nexport const name = 'biodsh-skills';\nexport const inject = ['skills', 'tools'];\n\nconst ROOT = path.join(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..', 'skills');\nconst RANK = 600; // BUNDLED_SKILL_RANK: project and user skills with the same name win\n\n// ---- frontmatter (name, description, optional whenToUse) ----\nfunction frontmatter(text) {\n  const m = /^---\\r?\\n([\\s\\S]*?)\\r?\\n---\\r?\\n?/.exec(text);\n  if (!m) return null;\n  const fm = {};\n  let key = null;\n  for (const line of m[1].split(/\\r?\\n/)) {\n    const kv = /^([A-Za-z][\\w-]*):\\s*(.*)$/.exec(line);\n    if (kv) { key = kv[1]; fm[key] = kv[2].replace(/^(['\"])(.*)\\1$/, '$2'); }\n    else if (key && /^\\s+\\S/.test(line)) fm[key] += ' ' + line.trim(); // folded continuation\n  }\n  return { fm, body: text.slice(m[0].length) };\n}\n\nfunction scan(dir, modelInvocable) {\n  const out = [];\n  if (!existsSync(dir)) return out;\n  for (const entry of readdirSync(dir)) {\n    const file = path.join(dir, entry, 'SKILL.md');\n    if (!existsSync(file) || !statSync(path.join(dir, entry)).isDirectory()) continue;\n    try {\n      const parsed = frontmatter(readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));\n      const n = parsed?.fm.name;\n      if (!n || !/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(n) || !parsed.fm.description) continue;\n      out.push({ name: n, description: parsed.fm.description.trim(), whenToUse: parsed.fm.whenToUse || undefined,\n        file, base: path.join(dir, entry), modelInvocable });\n    } catch { /* unreadable skill: skip, like skill-filesystem */ }\n  }\n  return out;\n}\n\n// ---- lexical search over the library (names weigh most; CJK text as character pairs) ----\nfunction terms(q) {\n  const s = String(q || '').toLowerCase();\n  const out = new Set(s.match(/[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.+-]*/g) || []);\n  const cjk = s.replace(/[^㐀-鿿]/g, '');\n  for (let i = 0; i < cjk.length - 1; i++) out.add(cjk.slice(i, i + 2));\n  return [...out].filter((t) => t.length > 1);\n}\nfunction score(skill, ts) {\n  const nm = skill.name.toLowerCase(), hay = `${nm} ${skill.description.toLowerCase()} ${(skill.whenToUse || '').toLowerCase()}`;\n  let sc = 0;\n  for (const t of ts) { if (nm.includes(t)) sc += 3; else if (hay.includes(t)) sc += 1; }\n  return sc;\n}\n\nexport function apply(ctx) {\n  const library = setting(ctx, 'library');\n  let cache = null;\n  const dir = (key, sub) => setting(ctx, key) || path.join(ROOT, sub);\n  const all = () => (cache ??= [...scan(dir('officialSkillsDir', 'official'), true), ...(library ? scan(dir('librarySkillsDir', 'library'), false) : [])]);\n  const candidate = (s) => ({\n    name: s.name, description: s.description, ...(s.whenToUse ? { whenToUse: s.whenToUse } : {}),\n    invocation: { modelInvocable: s.modelInvocable, userInvocable: true }, source: 'bundled', provider: 'biodsh',\n    path: s.file, resourceBase: { kind: 'directory', path: s.base }, rank: RANK, locator: s,\n  });\n  // registerProvider takes a factory: (control: { signal, invalidate }) => provider\n  ctx.skills.registerProvider(() => ({\n    name: 'biodsh',\n    list: async () => all().map(candidate),\n    get: async (c) => {\n      const s = c.locator;\n      const parsed = frontmatter(readFileSync(s.file, 'utf8'));\n      return { ...candidate(s), content: parsed ? parsed.body : '' };\n    },\n  }));\n  if (!library) return;\n\n  const tool = defineTool({\n    name: 'skill_library',\n    description: 'Search the BioDSH skill library (2000+ bioinformatics, clinical and data skills not listed in the session catalog) and load one. '\n      + 'Use it when the task needs a specific method, tool or database that no catalog skill covers: first search with a few English keywords, then load the best match by name and follow its instructions.',\n    parameters: {\n      query: { type: 'string', description: 'Keywords describing the method, tool or data type, e.g. \"cox proportional hazards time-varying\".' },\n      load: { type: 'string', description: 'Exact skill name from a previous search result to load its full instructions.' },\n    },\n    output: { schema: { type: 'string' }, render: (_args, value) => [{ type: 'text', text: value }] },\n    isConcurrencySafe: () => true,\n    async execute(args, exec) {\n      if (args.load) {\n        const lookup = { signal: exec.signal, scope: exec.agent };\n        const skill = await ctx.skills.get(String(args.load), lookup);\n        if (!skill) throw new Error(`skill \"${args.load}\" is unknown`);\n        const b = skill.resourceBase;\n        return [`<skill_content name=\"${skill.name}\">`, '<skill_resources>',\n          b?.kind === 'directory' ? `Base directory for this skill: ${b.path}\\nResolve relative paths mentioned by this skill against the base directory before using them. Load referenced resources only as needed.` : '',\n          '</skill_resources>', '', '<skill_instructions>', skill.content, '</skill_instructions>', '</skill_content>'].join('\\n');\n      }\n      const ts = terms(args.query);\n      if (!ts.length) throw new Error('give a query (keywords) or load (a skill name)');\n      const hits = all().map((s) => [score(s, ts), s]).filter(([sc]) => sc > 0)\n        .sort((a, b) => b[0] - a[0] || (a[1].name < b[1].name ? -1 : 1)).slice(0, setting(ctx, 'librarySearchLimit'));\n      if (!hits.length) return `No library skill matches \"${args.query}\". Proceed without one.`;\n      return hits.map(([, s]) => `- ${s.name}: ${s.description.replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 220)}`).join('\\n')\n        + '\\n\\nLoad one with skill_library {\"load\": \"<name>\"} only if it clearly fits the task.';\n    },\n    presentCall(args) {\n      return { card: 'generic', title: args.load ? `Load library skill ${args.load}` : `Search skill library: ${args.query ?? ''}`, kind: 'read', rawInput: args.load ?? args.query ?? '' };\n    },\n  });\n  ctx.tools.register(tool);\n}\n"

      "path": "packages/dsh-biodsh/lib/select.js",
      "content": "// BioDSH skill selection. When a new human message arrives, a model reads the whole skill catalog (official skills and\n// the community library; names plus short summaries, sorted so the prefix stays cacheable) and picks the skills whose\n// full instructions would materially help. High-fit picks are injected into that step in the same shape as an explicit\n// /name invocation (<skill_content>, source kind skill-invocation), so the agent does not have to decide to load them.\n// Background (2026-10 audits): embedding routing recalled 16% of the skills an oracle judged high-fit, and models almost\n// never called the skill tool on their own. Any failure (no credentials, timeout, unparsable answer) falls back silently.\nimport fs from 'node:fs';\nimport path from 'node:path';\nimport { setting } from './settings.js';\nimport { selectorPolicy, workspaceRoot } from './task_policy.js';\n\nexport const name = 'biodsh-skill-select';\nexport const inject = ['skills', 'llm'];\nconst TIMEOUT_MS = 60000;\nconst DESCRIPTION_CHARS = 160;\n\nconst SYSTEM_HEAD = 'You select skills for a biomedical data-analysis agent. Below is the complete skill catalog (name: summary).\\n\\n';\nconst SYSTEM_TAIL = '\\n\\nGiven the user request, choose at most 3 skills whose full instructions would MATERIALLY help carry out the specific '\n  + 'analysis the request needs (not merely the same broad field; not generic plotting/report/writing tools). Mark \"high\" only when the '\n  + 'skill prescribes the method the request actually asks for. Skills tagged [BioDSH] are validated BioDSH workflows: when one '\n  + 'covers the request, prefer it over a similar untagged skill. If none qualifies, return an empty list. Answer strictly as JSON: '\n  + '{\"skills\":[{\"name\":\"<exact catalog name>\",\"fit\":\"high|medium\",\"why\":\"<15 words>\"}]}';\n\nconst esc = (s) => String(s).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>');\n// Same shape as @deepseek-ai/dsh-skill renderSkillContent (shared by the skill tool and /name injections).\nexport function renderSkillContent(skill) {\n  const b = skill.resourceBase;\n  const hint = !b ? [`Resources for this skill are managed by provider \"${esc(skill.provider)}\".`, 'Load referenced resources only as needed.']\n    : b.kind === 'directory' ? [`Base directory for this skill: ${esc(b.path)}`, 'Resolve relative paths mentioned by this skill against the base directory before using them. Load referenced resources only as needed.']\n    : b.kind === 'url' ? [`Base URL for this skill: ${esc(b.url)}`, 'Resolve relative URLs mentioned by this skill against the base URL before using them. Load referenced resources only as needed.']\n    : [`Resources for this skill: ${esc(b.description)}`, 'Load referenced resources only as needed.'];\n  return [`<skill_content name=\"${esc(skill.name).replace(/\"/g, '"')}\">`, '<skill_resources>', ...hint, '</skill_resources>', '',\n    '<skill_instructions>', skill.content, '</skill_instructions>', '</skill_content>'].join('\\n');\n}\n\n// Text the human typed in this step's claimed messages (reminders and injections carry other source kinds).\nexport function humanText(messages) {\n  let q = '';\n  for (const m of messages || []) {\n    if (!m || m.source?.kind !== 'user') continue;\n    for (const b of m.content || []) if (b?.type === 'text' && typeof b.text === 'string') q += b.text + '\\n';\n  }\n  return q.trim();\n}\n\nexport function parseSelection(text, known) {\n  const m = String(text).match(/\\{[\\s\\S]*\\}/);\n  if (!m) return [];\n  const obj = JSON.parse(m[0]);\n  return (Array.isArray(obj.skills) ? obj.skills : []).filter((s) => s && known.has(s.name)).slice(0, 3)\n    .map((s) => ({ name: s.name, fit: s.fit === 'high' ? 'high' : 'medium', why: String(s.why || '').slice(0, 200) }));\n}\n\nexport function apply(ctx) {\n  const get = (k) => setting(ctx, k);\n  const dbg = (s) => { if (get('debug') || process.env.BIODSH_SELECT_DEBUG) { try { process.stderr.write(`[biodsh-select] ${s}\\n`); } catch {} } };\n  let catalogCache = null;\n\n  function route(agent) {\n    const provider = get('selectProvider'), model = get('selectModel');\n    if (provider && model) return { provider, model };\n    const prev = agent?.session?.requestHeader?.()?.config;\n    if (prev?.provider && prev?.model) return { provider: prev.provider, model: prev.model };\n    try { const d = ctx.get('agentDefaultModel')?.currentSelection?.(); if (d?.provider && d?.model) return { provider: d.provider, model: d.model }; } catch {}\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  async function catalog(agent, signal) {\n    const snap = await ctx.skills.snapshot({ scope: agent, signal });\n    // Official BioDSH skills (validated, in the session catalog) are tagged so the selector can prefer them.\n    const list = (snap?.skills || [])\n      .map((s) => [s.name, (s.provider === 'biodsh' && s.invocation?.modelInvocable ? '[BioDSH] ' : '')\n        + String(s.description || '').replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, DESCRIPTION_CHARS)])\n      .sort((a, b) => (a[0] < b[0] ? -1 : a[0] > b[0] ? 1 : 0));\n    const key = list.map((x) => x[0]).join(',');\n    if (catalogCache?.key !== key) {\n      catalogCache = { key, known: new Set(list.map((x) => x[0])), system: SYSTEM_HEAD + list.map(([n, d]) => `- ${n}: ${d}`).join('\\n') + SYSTEM_TAIL };\n    }\n    return catalogCache;\n  }\n\n  async function select(agent, query, outer) {\n    const r = route(agent);\n    if (!r) throw new Error('no model route for the selector');\n    const ac = new AbortController();\n    const to = setTimeout(() => ac.abort(new Error('selector timeout')), TIMEOUT_MS);\n    const onAbort = () => ac.abort(outer.reason);\n    outer?.addEventListener?.('abort', onAbort, { once: true });\n    let usage=null, failure=null;\n    try {\n      const { system, known } = await catalog(agent, ac.signal);\n      let text = '';\n      for await (const chunk of ctx.llm.stream({ ...r, system, maxTokens: 6000, signal: ac.signal,\n        messages: [{ role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'USER REQUEST:\\n' + query.slice(0, 3000) }] }] })) {\n        if (chunk.type === 'usage') usage=chunk.usage;\n        if (chunk.type === 'text-delta') text += chunk.text;\n        else if (chunk.type === 'finish' && (chunk.reason?.kind === 'error' || chunk.reason?.kind === 'aborted')) {\n          throw new Error(`${chunk.reason.failure?.code || chunk.reason.kind}: ${chunk.reason.failure?.message || ''}`);\n        }\n      }\n      dbg(`route ${r.provider}/${r.model}`);\n      return parseSelection(text, known);\n    } catch (e) { failure=String(e?.message || e); throw e; }\n    finally {\n      clearTimeout(to); outer?.removeEventListener?.('abort', onAbort);\n      // Benchmark accounting only (env set by the evaluation runner); never writes into a user's folder otherwise.\n      const root=process.env.BIODSH_USAGE_FILE ? workspaceRoot(ctx,agent) : null;\n      if (root) {\n        const file=path.join(root,'.biodsh-selector-usage.json');\n        const previous=fs.existsSync(file)?JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8')):{requests:[]};\n        previous.requests.push({usage,failure});fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(previous,null,2));\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  ctx.on('agent/pre-step', async (payload, next) => {\n    if (!get('selectEnabled')) return next();\n    let picked = null;\n    try {\n      const query = payload?.agent ? humanText(payload.messages) : '';\n      if (query) {\n        const policy=selectorPolicy({enabled:get('selectEnabled'),adaptive:get('selectAdaptive'),root:workspaceRoot(ctx,payload.agent),query});\n        dbg('policy '+policy.reason);\n        if (!policy.enabled) return next();\n        const t0 = Date.now();\n        picked = await select(payload.agent, query, payload.signal);\n        dbg(`picked ${JSON.stringify(picked)} in ${Date.now() - t0}ms`);\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      if (payload?.signal?.aborted || /\\b(?:402|429)\\b|insufficient.balance|rate.limit/i.test(String(e?.message || e))) throw e;\n      dbg('fallback: ' + (e?.message || e));\n    }\n    const decision = await next();\n    if (!picked?.length || !decision || decision.kind !== 'enter') return decision;\n    try {\n      // Skip skills already in this step (an explicit /name of the same skill, or a repeat).\n      const present = new Set((decision.messages || []).filter((m) => m.source?.kind === 'skill-invocation').map((m) => m.source.name));\n      const injections = [];\n      for (const s of picked.filter((x) => x.fit === 'high' && !present.has(x.name)).slice(0, get('selectMaxInject'))) {\n        const def = await ctx.skills.get(s.name, { scope: payload.agent, signal: payload.signal });\n        if (!def) continue;\n        injections.push({ id: globalThis.crypto.randomUUID(), role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'text', text: renderSkillContent(def) }],\n          source: { kind: 'skill-invocation', name: def.name, form: 'instructions' } });\n      }\n      dbg(`injected ${injections.map((m) => m.source.name).join(', ') || 'none'}`);\n      return injections.length ? { ...decision, messages: [...decision.messages, ...injections] } : decision;\n    } catch (e) {\n      if (payload?.signal?.aborted) throw e;\n      dbg('inject failed: ' + (e?.message || e));\n      return decision;\n    }\n  });\n}\n"

      "path": "packages/dsh-biodsh/lib/task_policy.js",
      "content": "import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';\nimport path from 'node:path';\nexport const CONTRACT_FILES = ['TABLE_CONTRACT.json', 'ROW_SETS.json', 'PUBLIC_OUTPUT_NAMING_AND_TYPES.json', 'CLAIMS.json'];\nexport function workspaceRoot(ctx, agent) {\n  // The working-directory service knows a child's own cwd; a subagent's session header still records its parent's.\n  let wd; try { wd = ctx.get('workingDirectory')?.get(agent?.session); } catch {}\n  return (typeof wd === 'string' && wd) || agent?.session?.header?.cwd;\n}\nexport function selectorPolicy({ enabled = true, adaptive = true, root, query = '', hasFile = existsSync }) {\n  if (!enabled) return { enabled: false, reason: 'disabled-by-setting' };\n  if (!adaptive) return { enabled: true, reason: 'adaptive-disabled' };\n  if (root && CONTRACT_FILES.some(n => hasFile(path.join(root, n)))) return { enabled: false, reason: 'public-output-contract' };\n  // Text-only requests must explicitly supply both a method and an output schema.\n  // A mere mention of CSV, ANSWER or a desired number is insufficient.\n  const method = /(?:use exactly|method\\s*:|prescribed method|严格使用|指定方法\\s*[:：])/i.test(query);\n  const schema = /(?:required columns\\s*:|primary key\\s*:|output schema\\s*:|列名\\s*[:：]|主键\\s*[:：])/i.test(query);\n  return { enabled: !(method && schema), reason: method && schema ? 'explicit-method-and-schema' : 'open-request' };\n}\n"

      "path": "packages/dsh-biodsh/lib/guard.js",
      "content": "// Verification-first convergence notices; thresholds remain configurable.\nimport { setting } from './settings.js';\nimport { workspaceRoot } from './task_policy.js';\nimport { roleOf } from './magi.js';\n\n// The MAGI arbiter reconciles two finished candidates: v18 evaluated it with a tighter budget (45/800 s, 60/1000 s, max 70).\nconst ARBITER = { guardSoftSteps: 45, guardSoftSeconds: 800, guardHardSteps: 60, guardHardSeconds: 1000, guardMaxSteps: 70 };\n\nexport const name = 'biodsh-step-guard';\n\nconst SOURCE = 'biodsh-step-guard';\nconst SOFT = (step, sec) => `本轮已用 ${step} 步、约 ${sec} 秒。优先保存完整代码，集中处理必要核验和已发现的问题，跑完核验再收尾。`\n  + '遵循公开方法和输出规范；不能用近似值满足精确合同。开放问答按要求输出末行 ANSWER，数值科学计数使用 ASCII e，保留题面要求的比例或百分比。';\nconst HARD = (step, sec) => `本轮已用 ${step} 步、约 ${sec} 秒，剩余预算有限。先保存代码和已有结果，优先完成关键核验。`\n  + '无法在预算内完成时如实报告未完成的部分与失败检查；不要猜数、跳过合同或宣称尚未完成的验证通过。';\n\nexport function apply(ctx) {\n  const base = (k) => setting(ctx, k);\n  const get = base;\n  const roles = new WeakMap();\n  const dbg = (s) => { if (get('debug') || process.env.BIODSH_GUARD_DEBUG) { try { process.stderr.write(`[biodsh-guard] ${s}\\n`); } catch {} } };\n  const state = new WeakMap(); // agent -> { turn, t0, soft, hard }\n  const notice = (text, summary) => ({ id: globalThis.crypto.randomUUID(), role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'text', text }],\n    source: { kind: SOURCE, form: 'notice', summary } });\n\n  ctx.on('agent/pre-step', async (payload, next) => {\n    if (payload?.agent && !roles.has(payload.agent)) roles.set(payload.agent, roleOf(workspaceRoot(ctx, payload.agent) || '.'));\n    const role = payload?.agent ? roles.get(payload.agent) : null;\n    const get = (k) => (role === 'arbiter' && k in ARBITER) ? ARBITER[k] : base(k);\n    if (!get('guardEnabled')) return next();\n    const step = Number(payload?.step) || 0;\n    const max = get('guardMaxSteps');\n    if (max > 0 && step > max) {\n      dbg(`turn ${payload.turn}: step ${step} > ${max}, rejecting`);\n      return { kind: 'reject' };\n    }\n    const decision = await next();\n    try {\n      if (!decision || decision.kind !== 'enter' || !payload?.agent) return decision;\n      let st = state.get(payload.agent);\n      if (!st || st.turn !== payload.turn) { st = { turn: payload.turn, t0: Date.now(), soft: false, hard: false }; state.set(payload.agent, st); }\n      const sec = Math.round((Date.now() - st.t0) / 1000);\n      let m = null;\n      if (!st.hard && (step >= get('guardHardSteps') || sec >= get('guardHardSeconds'))) { st.hard = st.soft = true; m = notice(HARD(step, sec), `final answer now (${step} steps, ${sec}s)`); }\n      else if (!st.soft && (step >= get('guardSoftSteps') || sec >= get('guardSoftSeconds'))) { st.soft = true; m = notice(SOFT(step, sec), `wrap up (${step} steps, ${sec}s)`); }\n      if (!m) return decision;\n      dbg(`turn ${payload.turn} step ${step} ${sec}s -> ${st.hard ? 'hard' : 'soft'}`);\n      return { ...decision, messages: [...(decision.messages || []), m] };\n    } catch (e) { dbg('error ' + (e?.message || e)); return decision; }\n  });\n}\n"

      "path": "packages/dsh-biodsh/lib/settings.js",
      "content": "// BioDSH settings: one Host row (id `biodsh`) whose Config is the user-facing settings of the bundle.\n//\n// A patch keyed by an existing entry replaces its `config` literally, so settings of plugins inside an agent preset\n// cannot be changed without restating the whole preset. A Host row with a Config becomes a settings namespace\n// instead (like agent-default-model): it shows in settings/describe, can be changed with settings.mutate or a\n// `biodsh:` section in settings.yaml, and needs no knowledge of the preset. Fields are volatile, so changes apply\n// to the next step without restarting dsh. The preset rows read it through ctx.get('biodsh'); without this row they\n// use their own defaults.\nimport { registerRequestMeter } from './request_meter.js';\nimport { hostImport } from './host.js';\n\nconst { Service } = await hostImport('@deepseek-ai/cordis');\nconst { default: z } = await hostImport('@deepseek-ai/schemastery');\n\nexport const DEFAULTS = {\n  coverageReviewEnabled: false,\n  semanticEnabled: true,\n  selectEnabled: true, selectAdaptive: true,\n  deliveryEnabled: true, reconcileChecks: false, magiMode: 'off', magiSteps: 60, magiSeconds: 900, deliveryMaxRepairs: 3, deliveryReplaySeconds: 120, deliveryPython: '', deliveryPythonArgs: [], selectProvider: '', selectModel: '', selectMaxInject: 2,\n  guardEnabled: true, guardSoftSteps: 60, guardSoftSeconds: 900, guardHardSteps: 80, guardHardSeconds: 1100, guardMaxSteps: 90,  // v18 (evaluated) thresholds\n  library: true, librarySearchLimit: 8, officialSkillsDir: '', librarySkillsDir: '', appContext: '', debug: false,\n};\n\nexport default class BioDSHSettings extends Service {\n  static Config = z.object({\n    coverageReviewEnabled: z.boolean().default(false).volatile().description('Require independent public-contract coverage review before accepting scientific outputs.'),\n    selectEnabled: z.boolean().default(DEFAULTS.selectEnabled).volatile().description('Pick and inject fitting skills for each new message.'),\n    selectAdaptive: z.boolean().default(true).volatile(),\n    deliveryEnabled: z.boolean().default(true).volatile(),\n    magiMode: z.union([z.const('off'), z.const('adaptive'), z.const('always')]).default('off').volatile().description('Experimental, off by default. BioDSH-MAGI (Multi-Analyst Gated Inspection) for tasks with a public output contract: off = single analyst; adaptive = a blind replicator and an arbiter with executable checks only when the analyst run shows risk; always = review every such task.'),\n    magiSteps: z.natural().default(60).volatile().description('MAGI adaptive: review a run that used at least this many steps.'),\n    magiSeconds: z.natural().default(900).volatile().description('MAGI adaptive: review a run that took at least this many seconds.'),\n    reconcileChecks: z.boolean().default(false).volatile().description('Require submission/reconcile_checks.py to pass on the clean replay (v17 reconciliation).'),\n    semanticEnabled: z.boolean().default(true).volatile().description('Experimental partial checks derived from original public inputs.'),\n    deliveryMaxRepairs: z.natural().default(3).volatile(),\n    deliveryReplaySeconds: z.natural().default(120).volatile(),\n    deliveryPython: z.string().default('').volatile(),\n    deliveryPythonArgs: z.array(z.string()).default([]).volatile(),\n    selectProvider: z.string().default('').volatile().description('Provider route for skill selection; empty uses the agent\\'s route, else the default model.'),\n    selectModel: z.string().default('').volatile().description('Model for skill selection; empty follows the same rule.'),\n    selectMaxInject: z.natural().default(DEFAULTS.selectMaxInject).volatile().description('High-fit skills injected per message.'),\n    guardEnabled: z.boolean().default(DEFAULTS.guardEnabled).volatile(),\n    guardSoftSteps: z.natural().default(DEFAULTS.guardSoftSteps).volatile().description('Ask to wrap up after this many steps in one turn.'),\n    guardSoftSeconds: z.natural().default(DEFAULTS.guardSoftSeconds).volatile().description('…or after this many seconds.'),\n    guardHardSteps: z.natural().default(DEFAULTS.guardHardSteps).volatile().description('Prioritize saved code and verification after this many steps.'),\n    guardHardSeconds: z.natural().default(DEFAULTS.guardHardSeconds).volatile().description('…or after this many seconds.'),\n    guardMaxSteps: z.natural().default(DEFAULTS.guardMaxSteps).volatile().description('End the turn after this many steps (0: no cap).'),\n    library: z.boolean().default(DEFAULTS.library).description('Register the 2000+ skill library and the skill_library tool (restart to apply).'),\n    librarySearchLimit: z.natural().default(DEFAULTS.librarySearchLimit).volatile(),\n    officialSkillsDir: z.string().default('').description('Directory of BioDSH skills; empty uses the copy inside the bundle (restart to apply).'),\n    librarySkillsDir: z.string().default('').description('Directory of the skill library; empty uses the copy inside the bundle (restart to apply).'),\n    appContext: z.string().default('').volatile().description('Extra instructions added after the persona, e.g. how an embedding app is used.'),\n    debug: z.boolean().default(DEFAULTS.debug).volatile().description('Log BioDSH decisions to stderr.'),\n  });\n\n  constructor(ctx, config) {\n    super(ctx, 'biodsh');\n    this.config = config;\n    registerRequestMeter(ctx);\n  }\n\n  /** Current value of one setting (volatile fields are references read on every call). */\n  get(key) {\n    const v = this.config?.[key];\n    return v && typeof v === 'object' && typeof v.get === 'function' ? v.get() : (v ?? DEFAULTS[key]);\n  }\n}\n\n/** Read one setting from the Host row when it is mounted, else from the given fallback config. */\nexport function setting(ctx, key, fallback) {\n  try { const s = ctx.get('biodsh'); if (s && typeof s.get === 'function') return s.get(key); } catch {}\n  return fallback?.[key] ?? DEFAULTS[key];\n}\n"

      "path": "packages/dsh-biodsh/lib/semantic_plan.js",
      "content": "import fs from 'node:fs';\r\nimport path from 'node:path';\r\nimport { createHash } from 'node:crypto';\r\n\r\nexport const PLAN_NAME = '.biodsh-semantic-plan.json';\r\nexport const SEMANTIC_INSTRUCTIONS = `v16: Deterministic public-source and clean replay checks are enabled. Before implementation, map output fields to their exact public definitions, source/formula, scope, units and missing-value rules. For every evidence statement distinguish a measured negative from missing measurement, lack of relevant source coverage, and unsupported external claims. Evaluate the stated proposition against actual inputs; neither a field name nor successful code execution establishes its scientific meaning. Inspect numerical diagnostics for numerical claims. Do not substitute a convenient proxy for a defined status. These are general principles, not task-specific answer rules. Model uncertainty alone is not a deterministic failure. Independent stages, if supplied later by the supervisor, are candidates rather than reference answers.\r\nFor tasks without original CSV/TSV inputs no executable source-rule plan is required. When original CSV/TSV inputs exist, read the public definitions and, before implementing the analysis, save .biodsh-semantic-plan.json in the workspace root. This is a partial executable interpretation, not proof of scientific correctness. Do not claim untested columns are verified.\r\nSchema: {\"version\":1,\"rules\":[{\"id\":\"unique-name\",\"operation\":\"aggregate|preserve|predicate\",\"source\":\"inputs/original.csv\",\"target\":\"declared-output.csv\",\"target_column\":\"column\",\"keys\":[[\"target_key\",\"source_key\"]],\"citation\":{\"path\":\"prompt.md\",\"quote\":\"exact public definition of at least 8 characters\"}}],\"unverified\":[\"columns or methods not expressible and why\"]}.\r\nUse unchanged ORIGINAL public CSV/TSV inputs, never generated intermediates. Match raw string identities. Each target key must be unique. For aggregate rules add \"aggregate\":{\"kind\":\"count_rows|count_distinct|sum|mean|ratio\"}; count_distinct/sum/mean require \"column\"; ratio requires nested \"numerator\" and \"denominator\" aggregate objects.
